title: The Promise That Remained
description: A childhood promise survives separation. Weed doubts it could ever be kept—until the bard corrects him.

Hyun.provenance: Approved Hyun B and expression refinement, imagegen concept references 2026-10-14. Translated by hand into articulated SVG: angular cheeks, layered hair, family warmth and eager reward expressions. Original fictional interpretation, not official art.

Bard.name: 诗人 · Bard
Bard.provenance: Original fictional middle-aged Serabourg bard, approximately forty as in the source. Swept brown hair, lean face and muted plum tunic, built with shared polished SVG geometry; not official artwork.

sources: Adapted from the supplied fingerprinted Legendary Moonlight Sculptor EPUB, Book 1 Chapter 3: shared childhood, Zahab’s gifts, separation, the promise fulfilled at court and referral to the living eyewitness maid. Stops before directions to her house and the visit. Local responses develop the existing exchange without changing events.
